propositions: The [rebar:<id>] citation doc section states the edge requirement but never specifies the edge must be DIRECT.
The verifier _edge_verified checks only direct edges (own deps and cited ticket's direct blocks) with no recursion.
A transitive or indirect dependency does not satisfy the citation edge requirement, causing the citation to fail closed with no warning.
The fix is docs-only: add a clause stating the upstream edge must be DIRECT and transitive deps do not count.
The change must be confined to the single doc file docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md.
